set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'EOF'

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("expected input and output paths")
in_path <- args[1]
out_path <- args[2]

d0 <- read.csv(in_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
needed <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area")
if (!all(needed %in% names(d0))) stop("required columns not found")

make_prop <- function(ratio) {
  z <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(z[1]); b <- as.numeric(z[2])
  a / (a + b)
}

mixtures <- d0[d0$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(mixtures) != 36) stop("expected 36 mixture rows")
mixtures$p <- vapply(mixtures$Ratio, make_prop, numeric(1))

pure_98 <- d0[d0$StrainNumber == "98", , drop = FALSE]
pure_287 <- d0[d0$StrainNumber == "287", , drop = FALSE]
pure_98$p <- 0
pure_287$p <- 1
full_raw <- rbind(mixtures[, c("p", "Area")], pure_98[, c("p", "Area")], pure_287[, c("p", "Area")])

aggregate_mean <- function(x) {
  aggregate(Area ~ p, data = x, FUN = mean)
}

interior_raw <- mixtures[, c("p", "Area")]
interior_mean <- aggregate_mean(interior_raw)
full_mean <- aggregate_mean(full_raw)

datasets <- list(
  interior_raw = interior_raw,
  interior_mean = interior_mean,
  full_raw = full_raw,
  full_mean = full_mean
)

fit_for_data <- function(dat) {
  list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = dat),
    natural_spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = dat)
  )
}

pred_at <- function(fit, x) predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))

max_on_interval <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 5001)
  vals <- pred_at(fit, grid)
  i <- which.max(vals)
  left <- grid[max(1L, i - 2L)]
  right <- grid[min(length(grid), i + 2L)]
  local <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(left, right),
                    maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)
  full <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(lower, upper),
                   maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)
  if (full$objective >= local$objective) full else local
}

rows <- list()
for (scope_name in names(datasets)) {
  dat <- datasets[[scope_name]]
  models <- fit_for_data(dat)
  observed_lower <- min(dat$p)
  observed_upper <- max(dat$p)

  for (model_name in names(models)) {
    fit <- models[[model_name]]
    observed_opt <- max_on_interval(fit, observed_lower, observed_upper)
    unit_opt <- max_on_interval(fit, 0, 1)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nrow(dat),
      edf = as.numeric(extractAIC(fit)[1]),
      aic = as.numeric(AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(BIC(fit)),
      adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
      observed_lower = observed_lower,
      observed_upper = observed_upper,
      optimum_p_observed_range = observed_opt$maximum,
      max_area_observed_range = observed_opt$objective,
      optimum_p_unit_range = unit_opt$maximum,
      max_area_unit_range = unit_opt$objective,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(summary_df, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

EOF
